blocks.path: Medicines for high cholesterol - High cholesterol > Medicine to lower your cholesterol
s: You might need medicine to lower your cholesterol if:

blocks.path: Medicines for high cholesterol - High cholesterol > Medicine to lower your cholesterol
s: your cholesterol level has not gone down after changing your diet and lifestyle

blocks.path: Medicines for high cholesterol - High cholesterol > Medicine to lower your cholesterol
s: you're at a high risk of having a heart attack or stroke

blocks.path: Medicines for high cholesterol - High cholesterol > Medicine to lower your cholesterol
s: Ask your doctor about the medicines you can take.

blocks.path: Medicines for high cholesterol - High cholesterol > Medicine to lower your cholesterol > Statins
s: Statins are the most common medicine for high cholesterol.

blocks.path: Medicines for high cholesterol - High cholesterol > Medicine to lower your cholesterol > Statins
s: They reduce the amount of cholesterol your body makes.

blocks.path: Medicines for high cholesterol - High cholesterol > Medicine to lower your cholesterol > Statins
s: You take a tablet once a day.
You usually need to take them for life.

blocks.path: Medicines for high cholesterol - High cholesterol > Medicine to lower your cholesterol > Other medicines for high cholesterol
s: Other medicines may be used if statins do not work or you cannot take statins.

blocks.path: Medicines for high cholesterol - High cholesterol > Medicine to lower your cholesterol > Other medicines for high cholesterol
Medicines for high cholesterol - High cholesterol > Medicine to lower your cholesterol > Other medicines for high cholesterol
s: other tablets – such as ezetimibe, sometimes with bempedoic acid

blocks.path: Medicines for high cholesterol - High cholesterol > Medicine to lower your cholesterol > Other medicines for high cholesterol
s: injections – such as alirocumab, evolocumab and inclisiran
